summary: Explains how the IPsec security services apply to IP multicast packets, which the base IPsec architecture mainly describes for unicast. It matters only to IPsec implementations that support multicast. This is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: Normal secure mail goes to one person in a sealed envelope. This memo explains how to seal a message that many people receive at once, so only the right group can read it.

questions: how does ipsec work with multicast
